The BF16 base model is proven CORRECT via TP2 control (14/14 twice) - the defect is reproduced across all three tested W4A16 export paths, not the source weights (OpenVINO int4 is a different, unaffected quantization route). Measured speed is also the worst of the pack (~15-16.5 tok/s chunk-rate vs EXL3 ~24.6 and OV ~28.5) and 262,144 context is unreachable on one card (fp8 KV max ~211K, bf16 ~106K). Nuance: the defect is narrow - the local AutoRound arm scored 9/10 on host-executed real code tasks, so 'W4A16 is defective' does not mean 'broken for code authoring'. | [source](https://github.com/SergiioB/intel-arc-pro-b70-inference-cookbook/blob/55eefeaeaa1e47b9e34b2fd20f55ffc1a8125c6c/docs/qwen38-27b/EXL3-XPU.md) |

Serving shape is an engine composite per the chart standard: grafted MTP5 draft arm to 65,536 (79.5 tok/s at 512, n=3, u8 KV) switching to the no-MTP u4-KV arm from 98,304 (17.2 tok/s at 98K down to 14.3 at 163,840, n=1 full-protocol ladder); the 196K-256K points quoted on other pages are 40-token capacity probes, not serving cells. Measured n=5 at the 230 W cap on the same INT4-GDN8 1-stage shard: median wall decode 4.95 tok/s at P512/G128 (4.97 at P128, 4.92 at P1024, 4.77 at P512/G64, 5.04 at P512/G256), package power flat near 102 W so the cap stays unused, Tmax about 66 C, quality PASS on every cell. A plugin-hint A/B moved nothing (empty PluginConfig 4.95 = LATENCY+f16 4.95, THROUGHPUT 4.92): the ceiling is the host loop (host embed, f32 logits copy, host argmax), so closing the gap needs on-device argmax or ov-genai on OpenVINO 2026.5, not plugin strings. Grid cells lack measured prompt-token accounting and a pullable upstream build identity, so ranking metrics stay withheld pending re-measure (docs/qwen38-27b/RE-MEASURE-TASKS.md). | [source](https://github.com/SergiioB/intel-arc-pro-b70-inference-cookbook/blob/55eefeaeaa1e47b9e34b2fd20f55ffc1a8125c6c/docs/qwen38-27b/OPENVINO-CASCADIA-REPORT.md) |

## Trust labels

- **Official lab:** measured under the cookbook's documented process.
- **Community reviewed:** schema and evidence reviewed; contributor controls the machine.
- **Validated:** an operational capability worked; any model-specific numeric records are published separately.
- **Provisional:** an early numeric claim is documented but lacks one or more required workload coordinates.
